scripts.vite:build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src='dist/widgets';const dest='public/js/widgets';if(!fs.existsSync(dest))fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dest,f)));console.log('Copied widgets to public/js/widgets');"
scripts.build: pnpm vite:build && hexo generate && node scripts/inject-custom.js
